title: Supported Kummer realization of a framed line bundle
statement:
Fix the finite coefficient datum $k,\ell,E,n,A=A_{E,n}$ with $n\geq1$ [def-pur-conventions], put $m=\ell^n$, and let $T$ be a separated finite-type $k$-scheme. Let $i:Z\hookrightarrow T$ be any closed immersion with complementary open $j:W\hookrightarrow T$ [def-weil-closed-immersion, def-weil-open-immersion]. Let $L$ be an invertible $\mathcal O_T$-module [def-sc-invertible-module], and fix a frame $s:\mathcal O_W\xrightarrow\sim L|_W$. Let $P=\underline{\operatorname{Isom}}(\mathcal O_T,L)$ be its $\mathbf G_m$-torsor [lem-sc-line-bundle-torsor], with specified section $s$ [def-amb-torsor-with-section]. Write $\beta(L,s)\in\operatorname{Ext}^1(i_*\mathbf Z_Z,\mathbf G_m)$ for the unique extension class with an equivariant map from $P$ to the fibre over the supported section one, sending $s$ to zero, as in [lem-sp-relative-torsor-extension]. Let $k_m\in\operatorname{Ext}^1(\mathbf G_m,\mu_m^{\mathrm{et}})$ be the actual Kummer extension [lem-amb-kummer-any-base]. Use the ordinary etale derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories] and the integral-to-module realization [def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-kummer-class].
There is a unique class
$$b_A(L,s)\in\operatorname{Ext}^2_A(i_*A_Z,\mu_m^{\mathrm{et}}\otimes_{\mathbf Z/m}A_T)$$
whose abelian realization, precomposed with $i_*\mathbf Z_Z\to i_*A_Z$, is the roots-coefficient image of the Yoneda splice $k_m[1]\circ\beta(L,s)$. Its supported-Hom realization [lem-amb-closed-support-hom], followed by the canonical etale/pro-etale comparison and the coefficient morphism $\sigma_T\rho_T$ of [def-pur-frame-class], defines a canonical class
$$b^{\mathrm{pro}}_A(L,s)\in H^2_Z(T_{\mathrm{proet}},A(1))$$
with supported cohomology [def-pur-support-cohomology]. This realization uses the Yoneda extension normalization, equivalently the Ext-normalized torsor class of [lem-amb-relative-torsor-cohomology], rather than the raw signed-cone lifting cocycle. It is invariant under isomorphisms of the pair $(L,s)$, commutes with etale pullback of the pair and with enlargement of support (restriction of $s$ to a smaller complementary open), and is additive as a function of the integral extension class $\beta$. Forgetting support gives the ordinary Kummer connecting image of the frame-torsor class $[P]$, with positive sign, followed by exactly the same roots coefficient morphism and site comparison. No module structure over $\mathbf Z/m$ on $\mathbf G_m$ is used. Here $Z$ need not be a Cartier divisor and $s$ need not extend to a global section of $L$.

source.place: Tag 03PL, lemma-kummer-sequence, and Tag 0A45, lemma-cohomology-with-support-triangle. Agent-stated framed-line refinement of the relative construction in blueprint main-20261015 lem-pur-divisor-class.proof.md, first sentence and final paragraph; the scalar and site identifications are part of the assertion, not claimed verbatim in Stacks.

proof.text: Take $G=\mathbf G_m$. The open-closed exact sequence at $\mathbf Z_T$ gives $0\to j_!\mathbf Z_W\to\mathbf Z_T\to i_*\mathbf Z_Z\to0$. The open adjunction and the constant-integer generator identify $\operatorname{Hom}(j_!\mathbf Z_W,F)$ with $F(W)$, with inclusion corresponding to $1$. Thus [lem-sp-relative-torsor-extension] applies to the given frame torsor and its section, giving exactly the characterized $\beta$. By [lem-pur-relative-extension-cohomology-normalization], its supported class is the Ext-normalized $c(P,s)$, including the specified complementary trivialization.

Since $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}k$, $m=\ell^n$ is invertible on $T$. Also $mA=0$: $\ell\in(\varpi_E)$ implies $\ell^n\in(\varpi_E^n)$. Apply the actual abelian Kummer sequence [lem-amb-kummer-any-base]. Its connecting morphism on Ext sends $\beta$ to $k_m[1]\circ\beta$ by [lem-sc-p1-derived-connecting-extclass] at degree one. Write $\gamma\in H^2_Z(T_{\mathrm{et}},\mu_m^{\mathrm{et}})$ for the supported-Hom realization of $k_m[1]\circ\beta$ [lem-amb-closed-support-hom]; it is natural in the derived coefficient object, so it equals the image of the realization of $\beta$ under the map induced by the derived morphism $k_m[1]$. No identification of this postcomposition with the termwise relative connecting map of [lem-amb-relative-torsor-cohomology] is used. This uses abelian sheaves for $\mathbf G_m$, never an $R=\mathbf Z/m$-module structure on it.

Put $B=\mu_m^{\mathrm{et}}\otimes_{\mathbf Z/m}A_T$ and $u(v)=v\otimes1$. Let $x=u[2]\circ k_m[1]\circ\beta\in\operatorname{Ext}^2_{\mathrm{Ab}}(i_*\mathbf Z_Z,U B)$. Apply [lem-sp-etale-supported-integral-derived-unit] with its positive integer $m$ and coefficient ring $A$. By its defining DerivedUnit bijection, with target $B[2]$, there is a unique $b_A:i_*A_Z\to B[2]$ whose exact-forgetting image precomposed with the integral generator is $x$. This proves both existence and the precise uniqueness in the statement; it does not infer uniqueness from the forgetful functor alone.

source.place: Tag 03AJ relative construction; integral-to-module adjunction supplied by cited derived-unit theorem

proof.text: Let $\gamma\in H_Z^2(T_{\mathrm{et}},\mu_m^{\mathrm{et}})$ be the supported realization of $k_m[1]\circ\beta$. Apply [lem-pur-supported-root-scalar-site-comparison] to $\gamma$. Its scalar arrow has abelian realization $u_*\gamma$, hence equals $b_A$ by Step 3. Its explicit equation $q\nu^{-1}u=\sigma_T\rho_T$ shows that the pro-etale supported realization is exactly $(\sigma_T\rho_T)_*\nu^*\gamma$. This defines $b_A^{\mathrm{pro}}(L,s)$ with exactly the coefficient morphism in [def-pur-frame-class]. The comparison applies because $B[0]$ is bounded below and the support is an arbitrary closed immersion.

source.place: Tag 03AJ construction followed by proetale.tex Tag 099W, lemma-compare-cohomology

proof.text: Isomorphic framed pairs induce isomorphic framed torsors, hence the same $\beta$ by the uniqueness in Step 1. For an etale pullback $h:T'\to T$ or $W'\subseteq W$, [lem-pur-relative-extension-cohomology-normalization] carries $\beta$ to the extension of the pulled-back pair, respectively to $q^*\beta$, the extension of the restricted pair, where $q:i'_*\mathbf Z_{Z'}\to i_*\mathbf Z_Z$ is restriction. Exact inverse image carries the Kummer sequence on $T$ to that on $T'$ and preserves Yoneda composites, so $h^{-1}(k_m[1]\circ\beta)=k'_m[1]\circ h^{-1}\beta$; precomposition by $q$ commutes with postcomposition by $k_m[1]$. The supported-Hom realization commutes with etale pullback, through the closed exchange $e$, by [lem-asd-supported-kummer-support-hom-naturality]. For $W'\subseteq W$, its normalization $z\mapsto(z\circ p,0)$ and $p=q\circ p'$ show that precomposition by $q$ becomes the enlargement map $(x,y)\mapsto(x,y|_{W'})$. The signed cone and site maps commute with coefficient morphisms, etale restriction and support enlargement by [lem-pur-divisor-relative-cone]. Step 4 therefore gives the corresponding equalities for $b_A^{\mathrm{pro}}$. Step 3's uniqueness gives the same compatibilities for $b_A$. Additivity in $\beta$ follows directly: shifted composition with $k_m$ and $u$ is additive, the DerivedUnit bijection is induced by additive functors and composition, and all the supported and site maps are homomorphisms.

source.place: Tag 03AJ relative functoriality; etale-cohomology.tex Tag 0A45 support triangle

proof.text: Forgetting support is precomposition by $\mathbf Z_T\to i_*\mathbf Z_Z$ under supported-Hom. By [lem-pur-relative-extension-cohomology-normalization], precomposition sends $\beta$ to the positive ordinary torsor class $[P]$. Naturality of composition therefore sends $k_m[1]\circ\beta$ to $k_m[1]\circ[P]$, the ordinary Kummer connecting image by [lem-sc-p1-derived-connecting-extclass]. Finally the signed relative/site comparison commutes with forgetting support and with the roots coefficient morphism by [lem-pur-divisor-relative-cone]. Its result is the ordinary positive Kummer image followed by precisely the coefficient and site maps used in Step 4. No extension of $s$ to $T$ was used.
